q-3488.name: Question 1
q-3488.problem: Which of the following is equivalent to $\frac{3{n}^{2}+15n+18}{{n}^{2}+4n+4}?$
q-3488.worked_solution:
We factor the numerator and denominator, canceling out any common factors that appear in both.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3{n}^{2}+15n+18}{{n}^{2}+4n+4} & =\frac{3({n}^{2}+5n+6)}{{n}^{2}+4n+4} \\  & =\frac{3(n+3)(n+2)}{(n+2)(n+2)} \\  & =\frac{3(n+3)\cancel{(n+2)}}{(n+2)\cancel{(n+2)}} \\  & =\frac{3(n+3)}{n+2} \\  & =\frac{3n+9}{n+2}.\end{aligned}
$$

q-3488.html:
Question 1
?

Which of the following is equivalent to 3n2+15n+18n2+4n+4?

a
3n+9n+3
b
3n+6n+3
c
3(n+2)n+3
d
3n+6n+2
e
3n+9n+2
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We factor the numerator and denominator, canceling out any common factors that appear in both.

3n2+15n+18n2+4n+4=3(n2+5n+6)n2+4n+4=3(n+3)(n+2)(n+2)(n+2)=3(n+3)(n+2)(n+2)(n+2)=3(n+3)n+2=3n+9n+2.

q-112994.name: Question 2
q-112994.problem: What is $\frac{5{h}^{2}-10h-75}{h+3}$ reduced to lowest terms?
q-112994.worked_solution:
The numerator can be factored as

$$
5{h}^{2}-10h-75=5({h}^{2}-2h-15)=5(h-5)(h+3).
$$

Canceling out any common factors that appear in the numerator and the denominator, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{5{h}^{2}-10h-75}{h+3} & = \\ \frac{5(h-5)(h+3)}{h+3} & = \\ \frac{5(h-5)\cancel{(h+3)}}{\cancel{h+3}} & = \\ \frac{5(h-5)}{1} & = \\ 5h-25 & .\end{aligned}
$$

q-113009.name: Question 3
q-113009.worked_solution:
The numerator can be factored as $wy+6y=y(w+6)$ and the denominator can be factored as ${w}^{2}+2w-24=(w+6)(w-4).$ Canceling out any common factors that appear in the numerator and the denominator, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{wy+6y}{{w}^{2}+2w-24} & =\frac{y(w+6)}{(w+6)(w-4)} \\  & =\frac{y\cancel{(w+6)}}{\cancel{(w+6)}(w-4)} \\  & =\frac{y}{w-4}.\end{aligned}
$$

q-113009.html:
Question 3
?

Simplify wy+6yw2+2w−24.

a
yw+6
b
yw−8
c
yw2w−4
d
wy+6
e
yw−4
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The numerator can be factored as wy+6y=y(w+6) and the denominator can be factored as w2+2w−24=(w+6)(w−4). Canceling out any common factors that appear in the numerator and the denominator, we get

wy+6yw2+2w−24=y(w+6)(w+6)(w−4)=y(w+6)(w+6)(w−4)=yw−4.
